test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given group of words.**

Make impure by adding inferior substances
solution:
The correct answer is '**Adulterate**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Adulterate**'.
 
• It means **'to make food or drink less pure or of lower quality by adding something to it'**. (किसी खाद्य पदार्थ में मिलावट करना; अपमिश्रण करना)
 
 
• *Example: I will not **adulterate** my schedule by filling it with unimportant tasks.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Adulterate.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning** of other words:

 
 
• **Obviate**: to remove a difficulty, problem or the need for something. (समस्या का निराकरण करना; निवारण करना)
 
• **Adjudicate**: to act as an official judge in a competition or to decide who is right when two people or groups disagree about something. (प्रतियोगिता या विवाद में अधिकृत रूप से निर्णय देना; फै़सला सुनाना)
 
• **Obliterate**: to remove all signs of something by destroying or covering it completely. (किसी वस्‍तु के सब चिह्नों को मिटा देना; उन्‍हें पूर्णतया नष्‍ट करना या छिपा देना; मिटाना)
 
 

40:Td59,

The correct answer is '**remove**'.
